prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one selectable idle/base sprite concept for the cute pixel-art game 小白鹅大冒险, region 很吓人的森林！. The three supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: existing mint round monster, smiling paper monster, white-haired heroine. Match their chunky visible square pixels, dark muted plum outlines, pastel storybook colors, simple soft clustered shading, charming childlike expression. ONE single spider character centered, full body with generous transparent padding, no text, no letters, no extra objects, no scenery, no ground shadow. Genuine transparent background. Neutral standing idle pose, front three-quarter view very slightly from above, face towards viewer and slightly right, readable at small game size. Exactly EIGHT short-to-medium rounded legs, four per side, separated silhouettes; round abdomen behind smaller head, cute recognizable spider anatomy. Two dominant friendly eyes, tiny secondary eye dots optional. Avoid photorealism, creepy realistic hair, fangs, sharp claws, thin noisy lines, smooth vector edges, 3D render, gradients, costumes, accessories, animation frames. Pixel sprite designed on approximately 128x128 logical pixel grid enlarged nearest-neighbor.
Variant A: plump lavender-gray fluffy ball spider. Wide squat silhouette, enormous round soft abdomen with a few chunky wool tufts, small charcoal-plum head with two big warm pink eyes and tiny shy smiling mouth. Eight stubby rounded bent purple legs, pale lilac face highlights. Endearing curious expression, plush creature but no fabric seams. Simple and distinctive.
